R16Cut.assessment: Reviewed all statements with AgreeOn, LocalTo, Bypass and the delayed pending-effect model. Closed dependency sets propagate state agreement; the directed ranked DAG proof traces any difference back along an unmediated path. A separator then yields outside equality. Workload.assessment: Reviewed all statements and the explicit finish/serial recurrences.
